sanskrit: yayoḥ sarvam idam ārpitaṃ vaśe bhūtaṃ ca nimiṣac ca ceṣṭat | tau mā vadantaṃ gṛhṇītām upadraṣṭāram atra māsyoc cheṣy ayathāvat prajāpate ||
english: In whose two powers all this universe is fixed — the existent and the moving, the blinking and the stirring — let those two seize the speaker here as witness; may he not sleep wrongly in this place, O Prajāpati.

sanskrit: yo mā vadantaṃ hṛdayena vācā vācā śrotreṇa manasā jihṛkṣāt | tam indro devo varuṇo bṛhaspatir īśāno devo abhi yātu mṛtyur yathā na jīvād uṣasaṃ tṛtīyām ||
english: Whoever would rob me as I speak — with heart, with speech, with speech, with ear, with mind — let divine Indra, Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, the lordly god, come upon him, and Death, so that he may not live to see the third dawn.

sanskrit: yo mā jihṛkṣād brahmīyān manyamāna itthaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ pramatir matīnām | tam indro devo varuṇo bṛhaspatir īśāno devo abhi yātu mṛtyur yathā na jīvād uṣasaṃ tṛtīyām ||
english: Whoever would rob me, thinking himself learned in sacred lore, though I am thus the knower, the Pramati among thinkers — let divine Indra, Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, the lordly god, come upon him, and Death, so that he may not live to see the third dawn.

sanskrit: pratyagvadhenāsyāpi dadhāmi prāṇaṃ mo dānaṃ vidata yo mā jihṛkṣāt | so asyāyur ā chinattu kuliśeneva vṛkṣaṃ yathā na jīvād uṣasaṃ tṛtīyām ||
english: I lay back his very breath upon him with a blow turned inward — do not give recognition to the one who would rob me. Let him cut off his own life-span as with an axe upon a tree, so that he may not live to see the third dawn.

sanskrit: yasyā akṣaram ekam eva paraḥ sahasrā ayutaṃ ca śākhāḥ | tasyā vāco vidathāvadantaṃ yo mā jihṛkṣāt sa nv etv ārtim ||
english: Of that Speech whose one syllable stands beyond thousands, and whose branches are ten thousand — let whoever would rob me as I speak in the assembly of that Speech now come to distress.

sanskrit: uṣā vā ādityam aindha sa uṣaseddha ud ait sa udyan prajābhya ātapat so 'pa tamo 'hata so 'nnādyam avārundha | apa tamo hate 'nnādo bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
english: Dawn kindled the Sun; kindled by Dawn he rose; rising, he shone upon the creatures; he smote away darkness; he gained the eating of food. When darkness is smitten, he becomes an eater of food — whoever knows this.

sanskrit: vāto vā agnim aindha sa vāteneddho 'jvalat so 'dīpyata so 'pa tamo 'hata so 'nnādyam avārundha | apa tamo hate 'nnādo bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
english: Wind kindled Fire; kindled by Wind he blazed; he flamed up; he smote away darkness; he gained the eating of food. When darkness is smitten, he becomes an eater of food — whoever knows this.

sanskrit: manomayī brāhmaṇam aindha sa brahmacaryam avasat sa vedam anv abrūta so 'pa tamo 'hata so 'nnādyam avārundha | apa tamo hate 'nnādo bhavati ya evaṃ veda ||
english: The mind-formed one kindled the Brahmin student; kindled, he dwelt in brahmacarya; he spoke the Veda in succession; he smote away darkness; he gained the eating of food. When darkness is smitten, he becomes an eater of food — whoever knows this.

sanskrit: homena pratiran prajāpate dampatī pari dadhāmi puṣṭyā | rāyaspoṣaṃ savitar ni yaccha jarāmṛtyū kṛṇuhi sarvavīrau ||
english: By the oblation, O Prajāpati, I surround this husband and wife for their flourishing and extension. Bestow upon them abundance of wealth, O Savitar; grant them death in old age, both fully heroic.

sanskrit: ayaṃ homo vardhayann etu dampatī prajāvantau paśuvantau suvīrau | rāyaspoṣaṃ savitar ni yaccha jarāmṛtyū kṛṇuhi sarvavīrau ||
english: May this oblation go forth increasing the husband and wife — rich in offspring, rich in cattle, of fine heroism. Bestow upon them abundance of wealth, O Savitar; grant them death in old age, both fully heroic.

sanskrit: gomantaṃ paśumantam aśvamantaṃ homaṃ dampatībhyāṃ juhomi | rāyaspoṣaṃ savitar ni yaccha jarāmṛtyū kṛṇuhi sarvavīrau ||
english: I pour this oblation rich in cattle, rich in livestock, rich in horses for the husband and wife. Bestow upon them abundance of wealth, O Savitar; grant them death in old age, both fully heroic.

sanskrit: jīvā stha jīvyāsaṃ sarvam āyur jīvyāsam ||
english: You are life-giving; may I live; may I live out my full lifespan.

sanskrit: upajīvā sthopa jīvyāsaṃ sarvam āyur jīvyāsam ||
english: You are sustaining life; may I live upon it; may I live out my full lifespan.

sanskrit: saṃjīvā stha saṃ jīvyāsaṃ sarvam āyur jīvyāsam ||
english: You are conjointly life-giving; may I live altogether; may I live out my full lifespan.

sanskrit: jīvalā stha jīvyāsaṃ sarvam āyur jīvyāsam ||
english: You are the vital ones; may I live; may I live out my full lifespan.

sanskrit: prajāpater ākūtir asi sāhasrī puṣṭiḥ | prajāpater ākūtyāhaṃ sāhasryā puṣṭyā sāhasrān paśūn puṣeyam ||
english: You are the intention of Prajāpati, a thousandfold nourishment. Through the intention of Prajāpati, through the thousandfold nourishment, may I nourish a thousand cattle.

sanskrit: bṛhaspater ākūtiḥ (…) | bṛhaspater ākūtyā (…) ||
english: You are the intention of Bṛhaspati, a thousandfold nourishment. Through the intention of Bṛhaspati, through the thousandfold nourishment, may I nourish a thousand cattle.

sanskrit: brahmaṇa ākūtir asi sāhasrī puṣṭiḥ | brahmaṇa ākūtyāhaṃ sāhasryā puṣṭyā sāhasrān paśūn puṣeyam ||
english: You are the intention of Brahman, a thousandfold nourishment. Through the intention of Brahman, through the thousandfold nourishment, may I nourish a thousand cattle.

sanskrit: virāḍ asi virājaṃ mā kṛṇu tasyās te yaśo bhakṣīya ||
english: You are Virāj; make me brilliant as Virāj. Of you who are such, may I partake of the glory.

sanskrit: svarāḍ asi svarājaṃ mā kṛṇu tasyās te madhu bhakṣīya ||
english: You are Svarāj; make me self-sovereign as Svarāj. Of you who are such, may I partake of the sweetness.

sanskrit: samrāḍ asi samrājaṃ mā kṛṇu tasyās te annaṃ bhakṣīya ||
english: You are Samrāj; make me universally sovereign as Samrāj. Of you who are such, may I partake of the food.

sanskrit: vīryāvatā te haviṣā juhomi jīvātave na martave | dakṣaṃ te bhadram āhārṣaṃ parā suvāmy āmayat ||
english: I pour for you the oblation rich in vitality — for life, not for death. I have brought you good strength and fortune; I drive away disease.

sanskrit: abhivīreṇa te (…) ||
english: I pour for you the oblation rich in heroic offspring — for life, not for death. I have brought you good strength and fortune; I drive away disease.

sanskrit: suvīreṇa te (…) ||
english: I pour for you the oblation rich in fine heroes — for life, not for death. I have brought you good strength and fortune; I drive away disease.

sanskrit: sarvavīreṇa te haviṣā juhomi jīvātave na martave | dakṣaṃ te bhadram āhārṣaṃ parā suvāmy āmayat ||
english: I pour for you the oblation rich in all heroes — for life, not for death. I have brought you good strength and fortune; I drive away disease.

sanskrit: prajāvatā te haviṣā juhomi garbham ā dhatsva yonyām | sa kāle jāyatāṃ punar daśame māsi sūtave ||
english: I pour for you the oblation rich in offspring — receive the embryo in the womb. May it be born again in due time, in the tenth month for delivery.

sanskrit: suprajasā te (…) ||
english: I pour for you the oblation rich in good offspring — receive the embryo in the womb. May it be born again in due time, in the tenth month for delivery.

sanskrit: suputreṇa te haviṣā juhomi garbham ā dhatsva yonyām | sa kāle jāyatāṃ punar daśame māsi sūtave ||
english: I pour for you the oblation rich in fine sons — receive the embryo in the womb. May it be born again in due time, in the tenth month for delivery.

sanskrit: bhūtaye te haviṣā juhomi- -imaṃ devāso abhi hiṅ karātha | asminn eva paśavaḥ saṃ viśantu catuṣpāda uta vā ye dvipādaḥ ||
english: I pour for you the oblation for prosperity — O gods, direct your blessing toward this one. May the cattle enter into him, both the four-footed and those that are two-footed.

sanskrit: vittaye te (…) ||
english: I pour for you the oblation for wealth — O gods, direct your blessing toward this one. May the cattle enter into him, both the four-footed and those that are two-footed.

sanskrit: svṛddhena te (…) ||
english: I pour for you the oblation with good increase — O gods, direct your blessing toward this one. May the cattle enter into him, both the four-footed and those that are two-footed.

sanskrit: samṛddhena te haviṣā juhomi- -imaṃ devāso abhi hiṅ karātha | asminn eva paśavaḥ saṃ viśantu catuṣpāda uta vā ye dvipādaḥ ||
english: I pour for you the oblation with complete prosperity — O gods, direct your blessing toward this one. May the cattle enter into him, both the four-footed and those that are two-footed.

sanskrit: kṣemyeṇa te haviṣā juhomi kṣemyo bhavāsi paśubhiś ca vīraiḥ | indrāgnī tvā sayujā sakhāyau viśvebhir devair anu saṃ dadetām ||
english: I pour for you the oblation for peaceful security; may you be settled in security with cattle and heroes. May Indra and Agni, yoked together as companions, together bestow you along with all the gods.

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhitena te haviṣā juhomi prati tiṣṭhāsi paśubhiḥ (…) ||
english: I pour for you the oblation with firm establishment; may you stand firm with cattle and heroes. May Indra and Agni, yoked together as companions, together bestow you along with all the gods.

sanskrit: sambhūtena te haviṣā juhomi saṃ bhavāsi paśubhiḥ (…) ||
english: I pour for you the oblation with complete becoming; may you come together fully with cattle and heroes. May Indra and Agni, yoked together as companions, together bestow you along with all the gods.

sanskrit: prabhūtena te haviṣā juhomi pra bhavāsi paśubhiś ca vīraiḥ | indrāgnī tvā sayujā sakhāyau viśvebhir devair anu saṃ dadetām ||
english: I pour for you the oblation with abundant being; may you excel with cattle and heroes. May Indra and Agni, yoked together as companions, together bestow you along with all the gods.
